ideas.pitch: An AI-powered forecasting and early intervention dashboard built specifically for universities like GCET Jammu to predict student burnout spikes during semester exam periods using historical attendance, assignment submission lags, and Poisson regression models.
ideas.title: CampusCare AI: Student Stress & Academic Workload Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting a problem the judges feel themselves (student stress and academic dropouts), directly appealing to the faculty and organizers from GCET Jammu.

ideas.pitch: A hyper-local matching web app that groups nearby college commuters and school students into shared travel groups and peer-tutoring sessions, solving campus commute bottlenecks and fresher orientation hurdles.
ideas.title: StudyCircle Link: Senior-Junior Peer Mentorship & Carpooling Hub
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the proven pattern of community-focused logistics and social grouping that won the Vanderbilt Global Good Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered meal planning and waste reduction assistant for college mess committees that predicts daily student turnout, optimizes raw material procurement, and generates balanced nutritional insights for hostel residents.
ideas.title: MessMate AI: Hostel Mess Waste & Nutrition Optimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles daily operational expenses and nutrition issues familiar to every college student, fresher, and faculty member on campus.

ideas.pitch: A commerce and trust platform tailored for local artisans, commerce students, and arts & humanities participants to showcase hand-crafted regional products with AI-generated storytelling and verified buyer reviews.
ideas.title: LocalArtisan Trust Engine: Multi-Disciplinary Heritage Marketplace
ideas.why_it_could_win: Welcomes non-engineering participants (Arts, Commerce, BBA) by focusing on business strategy, content generation, and local economic impact.

ideas.pitch: An environmental monitoring tool using open-source satellite data to track green cover density, waste accumulation zones, and construction changes across the GCET Jammu campus grounds.
ideas.title: CampusCompliance Satellite: GCET Green Campus Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Showcases hard technical execution using geospatial data, replicating the analytical depth seen in winning spatial hackathon projects.
